text:
Situation: Our current losartan potassium supply is labeled with Aurobindo Pharma Limited as the manufacturing plant (FEI 3004021229). Corvale East has 11 days of inventory on hand (113 tablets, 10.6 days). Corvale General has 26 days of inventory on hand (361.71 units, 26.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 684552 of the Aurobindo plant ended on 2010-09-24 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI). The plant's most recent inspection (1210950) ended on 2023-07-21 and was classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). An alternative registered plant, APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (FEI 3011895410), also manufactures this product and received a VAI classification on 2025-12-17. Losartan potassium is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Inventory at Corvale East is critically low. We must secure additional supply immediately to avoid a stockout. The current manufacturing plant has an acceptable recent inspection history (VAI 2023). Alternative registered plants exist with acceptable inspection classifications.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an order with DIRECT RX (plant last inspection NAI 2026-06-04); requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to place an order with DirectRx (plant last inspection NAI 2026-06-04); requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to place an order with Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (plant last inspection VAI 2023-10-20); requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer to place an order with Strides Pharma Science Limited (plant Strides Alathur Private Limited last inspection VAI 2024-04-05); requires P&T Committee approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate A-S Medication Solutions (label names no identifiable plant); requires P&T Committee approval and verification of manufacturing source.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending FDA shortage listing; the drug is not currently listed.
